children.text: पीयूषलहरी
children.translated_text: <s>Pīyūṣalaharī</s> (The Wave of Nectar)

children.text: अर्थात् गङ्गालहरी ॥
children.translated_text: That is, <s>Gaṅgālaharī</s> (The Wave of the Ganges).

children.text: क० ॥ सकल मही को परिपूरण सौभाग्य यही वेद
औ पुराणनको सरबससारहै । लीलाही करिकै जिन
children.translated_text: and <s>Purāṇas</s> declare it the essence of all. He who playfully

children.text: अखिलरच्यो है जग ऐसेत्रिपुरारिजूको बैभवउदारहै ॥
children.translated_text: created the whole world — such is the generous splendor of the enemy of the three cities (<s>Tripurāri</s>, i.e., <s>Śiva</s>).

children.text: देवनकोसुकृत अमोघप्रकट्योहैसही सुधातैंसरिससुतौ
children.translated_text: The meritorious deeds of the gods have manifestly borne fruit — truly, like nectar itself,

children.text: शोभाको अगारहै । सलिलतुम्हासे गंग मंगलहमारो
children.translated_text: it is a treasure-house of beauty. O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, your waters are our auspicious blessing,

children.text: नित पादपअमंगलको काटन कुठारहै १ दारिदजनित
children.translated_text: an axe ever ready to cut down inauspiciousness at every step. 1. For the destruction of the wretchedness born of poverty,

children.text: दीनताईकेबिदारनके कारणहै जिनको ते दृष्टि तैं निहारै
children.translated_text: you are the cause — those whom you regard with your glance

children.text: हैं । जिनकेहृदय दुरबासनानहूतैं युक्त ऐसे पावरनहूँ के
children.translated_text: are blessed. Even sinners in whose hearts dwell no foul desires,

children.text: पापनको हारै हैं ॥ मनकी अविद्यादीह द्रुमताहि काटन
children.translated_text: you remove their sins. To cut down the tree of ignorance and delusion of the mind,

children.text: को शिक्षाके करनहार तिनहि उचारै हैं । दायक हैं श्री
children.translated_text: you instruct and uplift them. O bestower of <s>Śrī</s> (prosperity),

children.text: के हमैंनीके मात गंगतेरे वारिके प्रवाह चाह सकल सु-
children.translated_text: Mother <s>Gaṅgā</s>, the flow of your waters fulfills all desires and

children.text: धारै हैं २ उदयमत्सर तातैं प्रकट्यो कपट जाके जननी
children.translated_text: purifies all. 2. From envy arose deceit, whose mother was

children.text: बिनायककी कोपके कटाक्ष संग । बारबार तिनको चला-
children.translated_text: the angry glance of <s>Vināyaka</s> (Gaṇeśa). Again and again driving them away,

children.text: इकै निहारैं तुम्हैं यातेई विदित कढ़ैक्षोभके भरेतरंग ॥
children.translated_text: they behold you — therefore it is known that you surge forth, filled with turbulent waves.

children.text: तेईवे अपारसब सुखके भँडार सदा करत बिहार ईश
children.translated_text: Those very ones are infinite storehouses of all happiness, ever sporting

children.text: शीशपै लिये उमंग । सकलहमारेते दुरित भरभंगकरो
children.translated_text: upon the head of Lord <s>Śiva</s> with great delight. Destroy all our sins completely, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>,

children.text: निकसे तो अंगते तरंगजे उतंगगंग ३ कबहूंही सुकृत न
children.translated_text: you who emerged from his body, your waves rising high. 3. Even those who have never performed any meritorious deed,

children.text: कीनो जिनतेऊ तुम्हैं सुमिरैं त्यों तिनहूँकी तंद्राको हरत
children.translated_text: when they remember you, you remove their drowsiness immediately,

children.text: हाल । जैसे मारतंडकी प्रचंडने मयूष सदा सबै अंधकार
children.translated_text: just as the fierce rays of the sun always dispel

children.text: को बिदारतहैं ततकाल ॥ सेवत सकल सुरनिशिदिन जल
children.translated_text: all darkness at once. Worshipped by all the gods day and night,

children.text: जाको ऐसी तेरी मूरति सो चूरति अघबिशाल । सोई त्रय
children.translated_text: your form, O waters, destroys great sins. That same

children.text: ताप मेरीब्याधि व्यथा अंतरकी एहोमातगंग तिन्हैं भंग
children.translated_text: threefold suffering — my disease, pain, and inner anguish — O Mother <s>Gaṅgā</s>, destroy them

children.text: करो ह्वै दयाल ४ तेरे आसरेते बलपायकै बिशाल गंग
children.translated_text: with compassion. 4. Gaining great strength from your refuge, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>,

children.text: बढ़योगर्वजाकूँ सोमैं तुमसों कहतसब । याही तैं वृंदारक
children.translated_text: his pride grew immense — I tell you all about him.

children.text: वृन्दनकी अवज्ञाकरी काहूकी न अबलगिमानी कछू
children.translated_text: Therefore he showed contempt for the hosts of gods, and no one

children.text: दाहदब ॥ जोपै कहूँ यासमै उदासता गहौगी अंब तो
children.translated_text: could reduce his pride or burning arrogance. But if somewhere

children.text: मैं निराधारनाहिं दूसरो अधार भव । मुख बिलखाय
children.translated_text: you, O Mother, should show indifference toward him, then I have no other support, no other refuge in this world of existence.

children.text: अति दीनता दिखायक हौ कौनके अगारीज ाइ रुदन
children.translated_text: With a weeping face, showing extreme wretchedness, to whose

children.text: करूंगो अब ५ तृण ज्यों तुरंत निजराज त्यागितेईनृप
children.translated_text: house shall I go and weep now? 5. Like a blade of grass, kings instantly abandon their kingdoms and

children.text: तेरे तीरहीको आय आसरो चितैधरैं । बैतकीलताबि-
children.translated_text: come to your banks to seek shelter, fixing their minds upon you.

children.text: लोल चैत चांदनीसे गंग तेरे वे तरंगनकी शोभाजे मनै
children.translated_text: Like the restless moonlight of <s>Caitra</s> (spring), O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, the beauty of your waves

children.text: हरैं ॥ तिनको दरसकरैं सरस पियूषहू ते स्वादित तु-
children.translated_text: captivates the mind. Beholding them, even sweeter than nectar,

children.text: म्हारो जल पेट तृप्ति ह्वै भरैं । ऐसेजे सदाईजन आनँद
children.translated_text: your water fills the belly with satisfaction.

children.text: उमंगभरे तुच्छ जाति मुक्तिकीहू हाँसीते कस्यो करैं ६
children.translated_text: Such people, always filled with joy and delight, though of lowly birth, laugh even at liberation — what can anyone do? 6.

children.text: तेरे वे प्रवाह में प्रभात काल न्हात आय रमणीनरेशन
children.translated_text: Those kings and noble men who come bathing in your currents at dawn,

children.text: की आनँदको छायकै । तिनहीं के कुच लपटानो हुतो
children.translated_text: surpassing even their delight with beautiful women —

children.text: मृगमद सोवह पखरिपस्यो तेरे जल आइकै ॥ जिनजिन
children.translated_text: the musk that clung to their lovers' breasts was washed away upon coming to your waters.

children.text: कौ हुतौ सुतेई वे कुरंगयूथ अतिही अनूप दिव्यरूप
children.translated_text: All those who had that fragrance — those herds of deer, most wondrously beautiful, adorned with divine form,

children.text: को बनायकै । सेवितहैं वृंदारक वृंदनसों चहूं ओर की-
children.translated_text: are worshipped by hosts of gods on all four sides. They have made

children.text: नो तिननंदन उद्यानबास जाइकै ७ एकबार सुमिरण
children.translated_text: their dwelling in the <s>Nandana</s> (divine pleasure garden). 7. Those who remember you even once,

children.text: करतजो नेक तुम्हैं तिनके पवित्र उरअंतर करतज्यों ।
children.translated_text: you purify their hearts within, just as

children.text: काननकोप्यारो यहनाम जो तुम्हारो अंब मुखतैं उचा
children.translated_text: this beloved name of yours, O Mother, when uttered from the mouth,

children.text: रतही पातकहरतन्यों ॥ औरेंयाजगत की जो दारूण
children.translated_text: destroys sins in that very manner.

children.text: त्रिविधिताप तिनके बिदारन में बारनधरतत्यों । प्राण
children.translated_text: And the dreadful threefold sufferings of this world — you destroy them like fire.

children.text: के पयानसमै सोई तुमनामगंग गंगकरो मेरेमुखकंजमें
children.translated_text: At the time of departure of life-breath, that very name of yours, O <s>Gaṅgā</s> — O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, let it sport

children.text: विलासयों ८ मंदाकिनि तेरे तीर तिनके निवासी जन
children.translated_text: upon my lotus-mouth. 8. O <s>Mandākinī</s>, those who dwell upon your banks —

children.text: जिनके जनममृत्यु दुखको करैंनिपात । परमसंतोषभरे
children.translated_text: for them, the sorrows of birth and death are cast down. Filled with supreme contentment,

children.text: क्रीड़ातहांकरैं काक तिनहूंकी महिमा बिशाल सो कही
children.translated_text: they sport there — even crows! Their glory is vast and

children.text: न जात ॥ बासी चिरकालनके सबसुखराशीतेई बासव
children.translated_text: cannot be told. Long-time dwellers on your banks, those repositories of all happiness,

children.text: के वैभवको तुच्छि गिनैं सबै भाँत । सोईतीर तेरे भव
children.translated_text: consider even <s>Indra's</s> splendor as trifling in every way.

children.text: भीरके हरनहार होउधीर मेरेश्रमकाटन को गंगमात ९
children.translated_text: Those very banks of yours remove the fear of worldly existence — be steadfast, O Mother <s>Gaṅgā</s>, in cutting away my weariness. 9.

children.text: तेरोशुद्धतत्त्व जो अकथ्यमात गंगतामें जीवनकी मन
children.translated_text: Your pure essence, O Mother <s>Gaṅgā</s>, is indescribable — to it, the mind,

children.text: बुद्धि बानीहूं नजावै है । जातरह्यो भेद जिन बेदनको
children.translated_text: intellect, and speech of living beings cannot reach. That mystery which has eluded even the <s>Vedas</s>,

children.text: तिनहूंते ताकोभेद कैसेहू जुकहतनआवै है ॥ याही तैं
children.translated_text: who could possibly tell its secret?

children.text: अखंड निराकार नित्य एकरस निजतेज तिमिर अ-
children.translated_text: Therefore, unbroken, formless, eternal, of one taste, your own radiance

children.text: ज्ञानको नशाबै है । खोजि खोजिहारे हैं विरंचि विष्णु
children.translated_text: dispels the darkness of ignorance. <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

children.text: वामदेव मेरीजड़बुद्धि ताहि कैसेकारिपावैहै १० बड़ेबड़े
children.translated_text: and <s>Śiva</s> have searched and grown weary — how then could my dull intellect ever attain it? 10. Those who perform great

children.text: दानयज्ञ करतबिधाननके निहचल लायध्यान आलस
children.translated_text: donations and sacrifices according to the prescribed rites, who steadfastly meditate without letting

children.text: को लावैना । करैं तपघोर जेसमूह चिरकालतऊ अति-
children.translated_text: laziness overcome them, who perform fierce austerities for a long time — even then the supremely inaccessible

children.text: हीअगम हरिपद ताहि पावैना ॥ एहोमात याते तेरी
children.translated_text: abode of <s>Hari</s> (Viṣṇu) they cannot attain. Therefore, O Mother, your glory is incomparable —

children.text: महिमा अतुलसुतो काहूबिधि कैसेहू जुमोपै तुलिआवै
children.translated_text: it cannot by any means whatsoever be weighed or measured.

children.text: ना । सोई पद सहज अखिल जगजीवनको देतै मात
children.translated_text: That very abode, the natural life-giving gift to all the world, O Mother

children.text: गंगनेक बारहिलगावैना ११ क्रोधसों मलिनमुख ऐसी
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṅgā</s>, even a single touch of yours bestows it. 11. With an angry, darkened face, <s>Umā</s> (Pārvatī)

children.text: उमाबारबार बरजै परमहठ करि पशुपतिकौं । तिनहूं
children.translated_text: again and again forbade <s>Paśupati</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) with great insistence.

children.text: को हठतजि सादरसमेत तुम्हैं धारैंनिज शीशपै प्रमोद
children.translated_text: Yet abandoning his stubbornness, he respectfully bore you upon his head, considering it a

children.text: मानि चितकौं ॥ मंगल करनवारी मूरतितुम्हारीताकी
children.translated_text: delight to his mind. Your auspicious form, the maker of blessings —

children.text: बरनैको लोकमाहिं महिमाकिगतिकौं । जाकेनेक दर-
children.translated_text: to describe its glory in the world, what measure could there be?

children.text: शन करतेही जीवनके दूरिहोत भवभय पावैंशुभमति
children.translated_text: By whose mere glance, the fears of worldly existence are removed from life, and one attains

children.text: कौं १२ निंदित जेकीने हैं उन्नत उनमत्तनिहू संसकार
children.translated_text: auspicious wisdom. 12. Those who are reviled, those who are fallen, the arrogant, the intoxicated,

children.text: हीननिहूँ नेकनाहिं आदरे । जिनके सुनतैं हिंसक निहू
children.translated_text: those devoid of sacred rites, those without any respect — even hearing of such people, whose very presence terrifies, robbers of gold and such — even they

children.text: के रोमहोत हेमके हरैया आदि तेऊतिनतैं डरे ॥ जिन
children.translated_text: are afraid of those sinners.

children.text: हूँकेतारन मैं आलस न लावतहौ पातकीनहूँतैं महापा-
children.translated_text: I shall not be lazy in ferrying them across, O great sinners, you who are storehouses of the greatest sins.

children.text: पनके आगरे । अधिक सबहीते तो महिमाकहांलौकहौं
children.translated_text: More than all others — how far shall I tell your glory?

children.text: तैंने गंगलोकनके पातक परैंकरे १३ सकल महीतल
children.translated_text: You, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, have cast off the sins of the people. 13. To remove the sorrow of the entire earth,

children.text: को शोकदूरिकरिबेको आओ सुरलोकतैं बिचारिकैदया
children.translated_text: you came from the celestial world, having considered it with compassion

children.text: हिये । बांधी जटाधरने जटाकेजूट ग्रंथमाहिं यतैंहीरहैं
children.translated_text: in your heart. The matted-haired one (<s>Śiva</s>) bound you in the knot of his matted locks — therefore remain

children.text: हमउरमैं बिचार किये ॥ करैनिरलोभनके मनकोसदाई
children.translated_text: in our hearts, having contemplated this. The mind that is always free from greed, is always made greedy by

children.text: लोभ सो तौ याप्रकारके तुम्हारे गुण मानिये । तिनही
children.translated_text: your virtues of this kind — such should be acknowledged. Those very

children.text: गुननको सकलभांतिही सों यह एहो मात मंदाकिनि
children.translated_text: virtues of yours in every way, this, O Mother <s>Mandākinī</s>,

children.text: फैल्यो दोष जानिये १४ नैननतैं अंध और पावनतैं
children.translated_text: is spread abroad — know it as a fault. 14. Those who are blind in their eyes, lame in their legs,

children.text: पंगुजे सुभावकरि बहैरे जिनकी जड़मति है । उक्तिनतैं
children.translated_text: deaf by nature, and dull of mind — those who are

children.text: बिकल ग्रसेजेभूतप्रेतनिहूँ त्यागे देवतानि तिनपाई नर्क
children.translated_text: distressed in speech, seized by ghosts and spirits, abandoned even by the gods — they have attained the way to

children.text: गतिहै ॥ अस्तभये जिनके सुकृत पापमोचन जे सबै
children.translated_text: hell. Those whose merits are exhausted, those who liberate from sin, all those

children.text: आधि ब्याधिनतैं पीड़ित पतितहै । ऐसे मानवनहूको
children.translated_text: afflicted by mental and physical ailments, the fallen —

children.text: रक्षाकरिबेको गंग औषध प्रसिद्ध तोसी तूही दरशति
children.translated_text: to protect even such humans, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, you are the renowned medicine —

children.text: है १५ सहजही शीतल सुभाव करि निरमल ऐसेगंग
children.translated_text: you alone are the manifest remedy. 15. Naturally cool, pure by nature, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>,

children.text: तेरेजल तिनकी महिमाअपार । बानीमन करिकैहूँ कह
children.translated_text: your waters — their glory is boundless.

children.text: तैं बनत नाहिं फैलिरही अवनीपै सबहिन तैं उदार ॥
children.translated_text: Speech and mind together cannot describe it — it has spread over the earth, more generous than all.

children.text: ताही महिमाको सुत सगर महीपति के उज्ज्वलअनूप
children.translated_text: That very glory — the sons of King <s>Sagara</s>, of brilliant, incomparable,

children.text: द्युति दिव्यरूप धारिधार । अंग अंग पुलकैं ते आनँद
children.translated_text: divine form — with every limb thrilling with ecstasy

children.text: उमंगन सों अजौं दिवलोकमाहिं गावतहैं बारबार १६
children.translated_text: and waves of joy, even now in the celestial world they sing it again and again. 16.

children.text: किये क्षुद्रपापन की तापनतप्योहै मन ऐसे मानवनको
children.translated_text: Those humans whose minds are scorched by the burning heat of petty sins,

children.text: ना कठिन बिचारहै । जिनके उधारनको एहोमातमंदा-
children.translated_text: their plight is not hard to contemplate. For their deliverance, O Mother <s>Mandākinī</s>,

children.text: किनि सुतौ तिहूँलोकमाहिं तीरथअपार है ॥ पापनके
children.translated_text: truly in all three worlds the <s>tīrthas</s> (sacred fords) are beyond number.

children.text: रूप पापकरत न मानैंशंक पापनको कबहूंना कीनोनि-
children.translated_text: Those who commit sins in the form of sins feel no shame —

children.text: स्तारहै । काऊ नैनतारे अपनाइते उधार यातैं सबते
children.translated_text: sins are never exhausted for them. Yet with just a glance you adopt them and deliver them — therefore

children.text: अधिक तेरी करनीउदार है १७ धर्मको निदान अरु
children.translated_text: your deeds are the most generous of all. 17. The foundation of <s>dharma</s> (righteousness) and

children.text: आनँदनवीननको कहतनआवे ऐसोसुंदर बिधान हैं ।
children.translated_text: the ever-new joy — such a beautiful arrangement cannot be described.

children.text: अमलअनूप तिहूँ लोकनको वस्त्ररूप तीरथ समूहन
children.translated_text: Spotless, incomparable, the garment of the three worlds, chief among all the gatherings

children.text: के मध्य में प्रधान हैं ॥ सकल कुबुद्धिन की बुद्धिन को
children.translated_text: of sacred fords — you purify the intellects of all those of corrupt minds.

children.text: शुद्ध कहै इन्दिरा अपारको उदार असथानहैं । हरौ सो
children.translated_text: The generous abode of boundless <s>Lakṣmī</s> (prosperity) — destroy

children.text: हमारो भवतापको समूह गंग जननी तुम्हारो बपु क-
children.translated_text: the multitude of our worldly suffering, O Mother <s>Gaṅgā</s> — your body is a

children.text: रुणा निधान हैं १८ धनमदिरातैं छके राते अतिमाते
children.translated_text: treasury of compassion. 18. Those who are drunk with the wine of wealth, flushed, exceedingly intoxicated,

children.text: दृग घूमत हैं बारबार भरे अभिमान हैं । ऐसेज महीप
children.translated_text: their eyes rolling again and again, filled with pride —

children.text: तिनहींके आगे दौरिदौरि बड़ों खेदजाकू ऐसो भ्रम्यो
children.translated_text: before such great kings one runs about in great distress, wandering

children.text: बिनामान हैं ॥ औरै सब सुकृत समूहनको नाशक में
children.translated_text: without honor. And all other accumulated merits are destroyed —

children.text: बड़ी जड़ बुद्धि जाकी अबिधि अजान हैं । मोकूंजो या
children.translated_text: my intellect is greatly dull, ignorant of proper conduct.

children.text: लोकमें तुम्हारो है वियोग गंग सोई यह मेरे अपराध
children.translated_text: That I am in this world separated from you, O <s>Gaṅgā</s> — that is the very cause of

children.text: को निदान हैं १९ पौनकी झकोरसंग चंचल तरंग तेरी
children.translated_text: my offense. 19. Your restless waves, stirred by the blowing wind,

children.text: तिनतैं चलायमान पंकज कतारहै । ताही तैं परागको
children.translated_text: set in motion the rows of lotuses. From those, a multitude

children.text: समूह रेणु पस्योअम्बु केसरिके रंगजाकी उपमाउदार
children.translated_text: of pollen dust has fallen upon the water — its color, like saffron,

children.text: है ॥ औरै देवनारिनके कुच जिनहीतें गिर्यो अगरको
children.translated_text: is a generous comparison. And from the breasts of divine women (<s>apsarās</s>), the paste

children.text: कीच मिल्यो तेरी जल धार है । सोई वह मेरो जगजाल
children.translated_text: of aloe-wood has fallen and mingled with your water-stream.

children.text: ताहि दूरिकरौ जंघापरियंत वारिशोभाको अगारहै २०
children.translated_text: That very web of worldly illusion of mine — remove it far away, for your water up to the thighs is a treasure-house of beauty. 20.

children.text: प्रथम रमापतिके चरण युगल कंज निर्मल नखनतैं
children.translated_text: First, from the pure nails of the twin lotus-feet of <s>Ramāpati</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s>),

children.text: तुम्हारीउतपति है । दूजेईशशीशजटाजूटको भवनकिये
children.translated_text: you were born. Second, the Lord (<s>Śiva</s>) made a dwelling of the matted locks upon his head,

children.text: करत निवास तू बिनोद सरसति है ॥ तीजे नष्टजीव
children.translated_text: and there you dwell, sporting delightfully.

children.text: पातकीनहूंके तारणकी बिधि है जे तिनमें तुम्हारी आ-
children.translated_text: Third, there is the method of delivering even fallen, sinful beings with destroyed lives — in this lies your

children.text: सकति है । देखि न सकतदुःख दीननको एहोगंग कौन
children.translated_text: attachment to them. Seeing the suffering of the wretched, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, for what

children.text: हेतु ते प्रभाव तेरोना जगतहै २१ शैलनके शिखर स-
children.translated_text: reason does your power not manifest in the world? 21. From the summits of mountains,

children.text: मूहन ते स्वच्छअति सरिता अनेक चली आवतहैं धा-
children.translated_text: many clear streams come flowing down.

children.text: इकै । तिनहींके मध्य ऐसी और कौनसीहै जो महेश
children.translated_text: Among them, which other river has ascended the matted locks of <s>Maheśa</s> (<s>Śiva</s>)

children.text: जटाजूट चढ़ी अतिसुखपाइकै ॥ धोयेकहो कौने पद
children.translated_text: and found such supreme bliss? Tell me, who else has washed

children.text: कमल रमापतिके अपने जलन सों मुदित मनभाइकै ।
children.translated_text: the lotus-feet of <s>Ramāpati</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s>) with their own waters, their mind gladdened and delighted?

children.text: सुरधुनी याते तेरे लेशके समान सरि और दूजी नाहिं
children.translated_text: O river of the gods (<s>Suradhunī</s>), therefore no other river is equal

children.text: ताहि कहैं कबिगाइकै २२ होइकै निशंक विधि जैसेहोय
children.translated_text: to even a fraction of you — so say the poets in their songs. 22. Becoming fearless, as fate may be,

children.text: तैसे सुतौ कस्योकरो ध्यानको समाधिहि लगायकै । सो-
children.translated_text: let one practice righteousness, applying oneself to the concentration of meditation.

children.text: योकरो सुखसेज शेषकी रमानिवास निरंतर नाच्योकरो
children.translated_text: Let one sleep on the blissful couch of <s>Śeṣa</s> (the cosmic serpent), the abode of <s>Ramā</s> (<s>Lakṣmī</s>), and let one dance unceasing,

children.text: शम्भु मन लायकै ॥ सबै पापमोचनके सकृत समूहन
children.translated_text: with <s>Śambhu</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) fixing his mind upon it. From all the accumulated merits of sin-removal,

children.text: ते हूजिये हमहिं परिपूरण सुभायकै । औरै तप दान के
children.translated_text: may we be completely fulfilled with natural goodness. And there is no need for the effort of

children.text: प्रयाससों न काम कछू जो पै जगजागौ तुम गंग सुख
children.translated_text: austerity and charity — if only the world awakens to you, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, happiness is

children.text: पायकै २३ मैंतो हूं अनाथ तुमनेह करियुक्त मात नष्ट
children.translated_text: attained. 23. I am an orphan — you, Mother, are full of affection; my state is ruined,

children.text: गतिमेरी तुम शुद्ध गति दानीहौ । डूब्यो भवसागर में
children.translated_text: you are the giver of pure liberation. Drowning in the ocean of worldly existence,

children.text: तुम विश्वतारणि हौ मैं रोग पीड़ित तुम सिद्धि वैद्य
children.translated_text: you are the deliverer of the universe, I am afflicted with disease, you are the accomplished physician —

children.text: मानीहौ ॥ मेरो तो हृदयमात तृष्णाकरि ब्याकुलहै सु-
children.translated_text: acknowledge this. My heart, O Mother, is tormented with craving —

children.text: धाको समुद्र आपवेदन बखानीहौ । याते शिशुशरणि
children.translated_text: you are the ocean of nectar, proclaim your own remedy. Therefore, O refuge of children,

children.text: तुम्हारी तकि आयो अब उचित बिधान सोई कीजै तुम
children.translated_text: I have come looking to you — now do what is proper, for you

children.text: स्यानीहौ २४ जादिनसों तेरी महि मंडल कल्यानी कथा
children.translated_text: are wise. 24. Since the day your auspicious story became known upon this earth,

children.text: प्रकटीहै तादिनसों कौतुकयोंछायोहै । यमके नगरमाहिं
children.translated_text: since that day, wonders have spread. In the city of <s>Yama</s> (god of death),

children.text: पातकी पुकारतहैं तिनको जो कोलाहल दुसह बिला-
children.translated_text: sinners cry out — and that unbearable tumult of theirs

children.text: योहै ॥ याते यमदूतदुरिदुरि जाय जहां तहां ढूंढिबे को
children.translated_text: has been dispelled. Therefore the messengers of <s>Yama</s>, running far and wide here and there, have devised

children.text: प्रेतनको यतन उपायो है । औरै देवतानके बिमाननके
children.translated_text: plans to search for the departed spirits.

children.text: यूथ मिलि दिवकी गलीन दलि धूमसों मचायोहै २५
children.translated_text: And hosts of celestial chariots of the gods, gathering together, have filled the streets of heaven with clouds of dust and commotion. 25.

children.text: काम और क्रोध दोनोंदीपित दवागनि ज्यों तिनहीं ते
children.translated_text: Desire and anger, both blazing like wildfire — from them has arisen

children.text: प्रकटी प्रबल जटाझरहै । ऐसो जो प्रचंड ज्वरताको जो
children.translated_text: a powerful cascade of matted locks. Such is the fierce multitude of fever

children.text: समूहतातेबसभयोपजरतमेरौबपुबरहै ॥ पौनकेसकाशते
children.translated_text: from which, overcome by fear, my body is burning.

children.text: प्रकाशमान गंगतेरेजलकेतरंगनको कणिका निकरहै ।
children.translated_text: Made radiant by the wind, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, the spray-drops from the waves of your water

children.text: तेई वे हमारे दिन दिन प्रतिदूरि करौ एहो मात दिव्य
children.translated_text: form a multitude — O Mother, divine river, remove these burdens of suffering from us day by day. 26. In the midst of which all moving and still creatures

children.text: नदी तापन के भर है २६ जाके मध्य चर थिर जीव
children.translated_text: dwell — that alone is the one generous abode of the three worlds.

children.text: सब बास करैं जोई तिहुँलोकनको एकओकहै उदार ।
children.translated_text: That very cosmic egg (<s>brahmāṇḍa</s>), amid its trembling waves, like a

children.text: सोई ब्रह्मण्ड ताकी तरल तरंगनसों तिंदुकके फलसम
children.translated_text: <s>tinduka</s> (persimmon) fruit,

children.text: तामें चलै बारबार ॥ औरै त्रिपुरारिके अपार जटाजूटन
children.translated_text: rolls about again and again. And in the boundless matted locks of <s>Tripurāri</s> (<s>Śiva</s>),

children.text: में जिटिरह्यो जोई शोभा सुखको सकल सार । सोईयह
children.translated_text: what remained fixed — that is the very essence of beauty and joy.

children.text: मात तेरे जलनको ब्रात अबहरौ सो हमारौ तन ताप
children.translated_text: That same, O Mother, is the multitude of your waters — now remove the entire burden

children.text: को अखिल भार २७ जाके तारिबेकीविधि तामें तत-
children.translated_text: of bodily suffering from us. 27. Hearing of your method of deliverance, wherein instantly

children.text: काल इहां तीरथ समूह सुनि लाजन मरत हैं । औरै
children.translated_text: all the multitudes of sacred fords here die of shame.

children.text: त्रिपुरारि आदि देवता सकल जाके पातक विचारिकर
children.translated_text: And <s>Tripurāri</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) and all the gods, contemplating the sins of those sinners,

children.text: कानन धरत हैं ॥ दयाकरि कोमल हृदय जाको ऐसी
children.translated_text: place their hands over their ears. With a compassionate, tender heart — such are you —

children.text: तुम पापी जुमैंऐसो ताहि पावनकरतहैं । याही ते तुम्हारे
children.translated_text: you purify even a sinner such as I.

children.text: गुण तीरथ सुदेवनको पातक मथन गर्व खंडन करतहैं
children.translated_text: Therefore your virtues crush the pride of sacred fords and gods, churning away their sins. 28. Even without countless remedies for sins, the minds of such people

children.text: २८ पापनकी अमितचिकित्सानहूते मनतिनके चलाय
children.translated_text: remain restless and fearless.

children.text: मान ह्वै रहै निडर है । ऐसे श्वपचनके समूह तिनहूंन
children.translated_text: Even such multitudes of outcasts you have not abandoned, nor their defiled

children.text: तजी तिनहींकी मलिन सभानको निकर है ॥ जिनही
children.translated_text: assemblies. I, who am the very home

children.text: सभानको सदन ऐसो पातकी मैं ताहू के उधारन को
children.translated_text: of such sinful assemblies — even for my deliverance,

children.text: बांधौ परिकर है । ऐसी तुम ए हो मात तिनकी बड़ाई
children.translated_text: you gird your loins. Such are you, O Mother — to tell of their greatness,

children.text: ताहि करिबेको समरथ ऐसो कौननर है २९ यह चिर-
children.translated_text: what man is capable? 29. For a long time this has been my desire for you —

children.text: कालसों तुम्हारे अभिलाषहौ कि ऐसोमोहिं अबलगि
children.translated_text: that until now, I, such a sinner,

children.text: पातकी मिल्योनही । जाके तारिबे ते यह सकल जगत
children.translated_text: have not met you. By your deliverance, this entire world

children.text: मध्य बिस्मय अपार सबहिनकै भस्योसही ॥ सोई यह
children.translated_text: has been filled with boundless wonder for all.

children.text: मैंतौ सुर तटिनी तुम्हारे तट अतिही सनेहकरि चाह-
children.translated_text: That same am I — O river of the gods, with great affection

children.text: ना चितै यही । आयोसोई कीजिये सफल ताहि एहो
children.translated_text: at your bank, this is my desire. I have come — now fulfill it, O

children.text: गंग जोई अभिलाष माततुम्हारे मनैरही ३० निशि
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṅgā</s> — whatever desire, O Mother, has remained in your mind. 30. Day and night,

children.text: दिन मेरी नीचसेवनमें आसकति त्योंहीं वृथाबचनको
children.translated_text: my attachment to the service of the lowly, and the repeated

children.text: करिबोहै बारबार । औरै ज्यों कुतर्कन में कीनोहै प्रचार
children.translated_text: uttering of vain words — and the way I have indulged in false arguments,

children.text: मैंने झूठीपर चुगलीको मननकरनहार ॥ मेरे या प्रकार
children.translated_text: I who am a ruminator on lies and slander.

children.text: के अपार गुण तिन्हैं सुनि सुनिकरिएहो मात तुमहीं
children.translated_text: Hearing of my innumerable qualities of this kind, O Mother, you alone

children.text: करो बिचार । छिनहूं जो मोसे पातकीको मुखदेखै ऐसो
children.translated_text: must decide. Who else in this world besides you, so supremely generous,

children.text: तुम बिना और कौन जगमें अतिउदार ३१ एहो मात
children.translated_text: would even look at the face of a sinner such as I? 31. O Mother

children.text: गंग या जगतमाहिं जिनहीके हुये जो बिशाल नैन तोपै
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṅgā</s>, in this world those who have been given great eyes — even so,

children.text: कहा काम हैं । जिनसों न कबहूं परम रमणीक अति
children.translated_text: of what use are they? For they have never once beheld

children.text: मूरति तुम्हारी ना निहारी अभिरामहैं ॥ औरैजिन प्राणि
children.translated_text: your supremely beautiful, most lovely form.

children.text: नके श्रवण उदारमात बारबार तिनकोधिकार परिनाम
children.translated_text: And those living beings who have generous ears, O Mother — again and again, their right

children.text: हैं । जिनसोंन कबहूंतुम्हारी जेतरंगनको कलकलशब्द
children.translated_text: and reward is this: they have never heard the gurgling sound

children.text: जोसुन्योन सुखधामहैं ३२ सुकृतीपुमान तौस्वइच्छाते
children.translated_text: of your waves — that abode of happiness. 32. A meritorious man, of his own will,

children.text: बिमानबैठि जातसुरपुरको प्रमोद उरलाइकै । औरैपर-
children.translated_text: seated in a celestial chariot, goes to the city of the gods, taking joy to his heart. But the helpless

children.text: बशहोइ पातकी अपारतहां नरकनभीतर परतदुखपा-
children.translated_text: sinner falls beyond measure into the hells,

children.text: इकै ॥ अशुभमयमूरति जादेशकीतादेशहूमेंरहतबिभा-
children.translated_text: finding suffering. An inauspicious form — whatever land has such a form, in that very land remains,

children.text: ग यहऐसोनितछाइकै । लीलाकरिकेई जिनपातकबि-
children.translated_text: spreading its shadow forever. Playfully you have destroyed the sins of those — wherever you

children.text: नाशकीने ऐसीजहां तुमनाबिराजो मातआइकै ३३ मा-
children.translated_text: have not yet come to preside, O Mother, please come. 33. Those who kill

children.text: रतदुजनहीको गुरुत्रियइच्छाकरै हरैंजेकनकअरुकरैं
children.translated_text: wicked men, who desire their teacher's wife, who steal gold, and who

children.text: मद्यपानहैं । ऐसेहूअपारपातकीजे मातअंतसमय त्या-
children.translated_text: drink wine — even such boundless sinners, O Mother, at the time of death,

children.text: गतशरीरनिज तेरेविषेआनिहैं ॥ बड़ेबड़ेदानी बहुयज्ञ-
children.translated_text: having abandoned their bodies, are brought into your presence.

children.text: नकरनहारे जात जिनलोकनमें सुकृतबिधानहैं । तिन-
children.translated_text: Great donors and performers of many <s>yajñas</s> (sacrifices), those who go to those worlds through meritorious acts —

children.text: हूतेऊपर बिमानबैठि क्रीड़ाकरैं करैंदेवजिनके चरण स-
children.translated_text: above even them, seated in celestial chariots, they sport, and the gods bow

children.text: नमानहैं ३४ सुमनसमूहको अलभ्यमकरंद जाकूं जो
children.translated_text: at their feet with respect. 34. The inaccessible nectar of the multitude of flowers, which

children.text: वहपवन निशिबासर चुरीवैहै । बिरहकृपाणजाते पीड़ित
children.translated_text: the wind steals day and night —

children.text: बिरहीजन तिनहूंके प्राणनको छिनमेंदहावैहै ॥ लीला
children.translated_text: those lovers afflicted by the sword of separation, that wind burns their life-breath in an instant.

children.text: करिचलित लहरितेरी तिनहींको क्षोभताते ऐसोहू प-
children.translated_text: But your waves, playfully moving, even such a wind, being agitated by them,

children.text: वित्रहोइधावैहै । दिनप्रतिसो वहसमीर तिहुँलोकनको
children.translated_text: becomes purified and rushes forth. Day after day, that very breeze purifies

children.text: पावनकरत और पातकनशावैहै ३५ केतेतौजगतमा-
children.translated_text: the three worlds and destroys sins. 35. Some humans in this world constantly

children.text: हिंमानव निरंतरयालोकको अरथरचै शुद्धमनजिनको ।
children.translated_text: labor for worldly wealth with pure minds.

children.text: कितनेहू ऐसेपरलोकनमें प्रीतिकरैं कष्टरीति साधिकै न
children.translated_text: Some have love for the next world and practice the path of hardship, not being greedy

children.text: करैं लोभतनको । मैंतौमातगंग कृपारावरीकोसंगपाय
children.translated_text: for bodily comforts. But I, O Mother <s>Gaṅgā</s>, obtaining the company of the rain-cloud of compassion,

children.text: सैनकरो सुखसजि तजिकै यतनको । सबैभांति निहचैं
children.translated_text: shall fashion my happiness effortlessly, abandoning all striving.

children.text: कपटत्यागितेरेविषे धारणकस्योहै भारदोनूं भुवननको
children.translated_text: With complete certainty in every way, abandoning deceit, I have resolved to take refuge in you, the bearer of the burden of both worlds. 36.

children.text: ३६ पाखंडी पतितऔअधम संसकारहीन ऐसेमानवन
children.translated_text: Heretics, the fallen, the base, those devoid of sacred rites — such humans,

children.text: कीजे सुनियेसभामही । तिनहीसभानकी सहायकरिबेकू
children.translated_text: listen to their assemblies.

children.text: जैसे आपसमरथहौ सनेहकरिकेसही ॥ त्योंहींमातगंग
children.translated_text: You are capable of helping even those assemblies, truly, with affection.

children.text: दुरितनके समूहनमें मेरोहूसेनेह निशिबासररहैयही ।
children.translated_text: Likewise, O Mother <s>Gaṅgā</s>, amid the multitudes of sins, my affection too remains

children.text: यातेजोसुभावजाको जैसोयाजगतमाहिं काहूबिधिकैसे
children.translated_text: day and night — this very thing. Therefore, whatever one's nature may be in this world,

children.text: हू जुत्यागतबनैं नही ३७ समयप्रदोषतामेंनृत्यकरैं ऐसे
children.translated_text: by no means whatsoever can it be abandoned. 37. At the evening hour <s>Śiva</s> dances —

children.text: शिव तिनकीजोलीलाताते उद्धतजटाअपाराजिनकोजो
children.translated_text: from his sport, his uplifted matted locks are boundless.

children.text: अंतजामें चंचलतरंगतेरी तेईजिमिकांपतहैं भुजानको
children.translated_text: In the last watch of the night, your restless waves tremble like

children.text: बिसतार ॥ बिलमाहिं क्रीड़ाकरैं ऐसेजलताकोरव सोई
children.translated_text: the spread of his arms. The sound of the water splashing in the holes is like

children.text: मनोंचहूँओर डमरुनको डंकार । देवसरि तुम्हारो या
children.translated_text: the beating of <s>ḍamarus</s> (small drums) on all sides.

children.text: विधिको तांडव नृत्यसो वह हमारोहरो तापको अखिल
children.translated_text: O divine river, this <s>tāṇḍava</s> (cosmic dance) of yours — may it remove

children.text: भार ३८ तेरेबिषे धारणकस्योहै मैंसकल विधि कुशल ह
children.translated_text: the entire burden of our suffering. 38. I have resolved to take refuge in you in every way — our well-being,

children.text: मारो जाकी चिंता ताकोभारहै । जोपैयाविषम समै एहो
children.translated_text: whose care is a burden to us. If in this difficult time, O Mother

children.text: मात मंदाकिनि त्याग न करोगी मोसे पातकअगारहै ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Mandākinī</s>, you do not abandon me, a storehouse of sins,

children.text: तौ जो शरणागत सहाय बिसवास तेरो ह्वे है त्रिभुवन
children.translated_text: then the trust of those who have taken refuge in you, a help throughout the three worlds,

children.text: मैंते अस्तइहबारहै । दीन प्रतिपालकजो करुणातुम्हा-
children.translated_text: will be exhausted this time. The protection of the wretched, which is your compassion —

children.text: री अब सोऊ यहनिहचैंही होगी निराधारहै ३९ उछ-
children.translated_text: that too will now certainly become without foundation. 39. Leaping forth from the knot of matted locks of <s>Tripurāri</s> (<s>Śiva</s>),

children.text: रिजटाके जूटन तैं त्रिपुरारिजूके खेलतसीमंत कीजै शर
children.translated_text: sporting, adorning the parting of his hair —

children.text: णी मैं लैउमंग । देखततिनहिं ऐसे पारवती बाम अंक
children.translated_text: take me in with delight. Seeing this, <s>Pārvatī</s>, seated at his left side,

children.text: अतिही सनेह ताते बैठीहुतीपतिसंग ॥ मानिकै सपत्नी
children.translated_text: with great affection beside her Lord,

children.text: जो कोमलद्युति मान हाथ तासोंकरै दूरि तिन्हैंकोपभरी
children.translated_text: considering you a co-wife, with tender radiance and jealous pride, pushes you away from him,

children.text: अंगअंग । सोई नित अधिक सबन ते उदयकिये बर-
children.translated_text: her every limb filled with anger. Yet rising ever higher above all, you flow on,

children.text: तो अनंद भरी तेरी ये तरंगगंग ४० पूजनीक तुम जो
children.translated_text: filled with endless joy — these are your waves, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>. 40. You who are worthy of worship —

children.text: तिनको याजगतमाहिं कौनसे हैं जिन्ने नाहिंसरनि वि-
children.translated_text: in this world, who are they who have not taken your refuge

children.text: धानिये । फलकी जेइच्छाकरैं इच्छाफल तिन्हैं देत सो
children.translated_text: according to prescribed rites? Those who desire fruits, you grant them their desired fruits — recognize

children.text: यह उपाधिगंग मेरे उरमानिये ॥ मैं तो मात शपथ तु-
children.translated_text: this gift, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, in my heart.

children.text: म्हारी खाइ ककौं अबै यामें आपनेक कछू झूठनाहिं
children.translated_text: I, O Mother, swear by you and declare — in this there is nothing

children.text: जानिये । मेरो मनतुम विषे सहज सुभावहीते करत
children.translated_text: false, know this. My mind naturally and spontaneously

children.text: सनेह यह निहचैं प्रमानिये ४१ एकबेर सहज सुभाव-
children.translated_text: loves you — know this with certainty as proven. 41. Once, by their natural disposition alone,

children.text: हीते जगमाहिंजीवजे हैं तिन्ने ताको तिलक लगायो
children.translated_text: the living beings in this world — those whom you have marked with the <s>tilaka</s> (auspicious mark)

children.text: भाल । जिनको अज्ञानसोई तमके समान ताहिदूरिकरि
children.translated_text: upon their foreheads — whose ignorance is like darkness, to remove it

children.text: बे को सोतरनकी किरणिभाल ॥ औरैजो बिरंचि खोंटे
children.translated_text: far away, you are the ray of the sun upon their brows.

children.text: अंकनकी पांति लिखी ताही छिनतिनको मिटावत है
children.translated_text: And whatever unfavorable lines <s>Brahmā</s> (the Creator) had inscribed, those you erase

children.text: ततकाल । सोई वह मृत्युका मनोहर तुम्हारीगंग दूरि
children.translated_text: for them in an instant. That same, O charming one of death's realm, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>,

children.text: करो मात मेरे शोकको समूहहाल ४२ तोते वितरिक्त
children.translated_text: remove, O Mother, the multitude of my sorrows now. 42. Those humans who are attached in mind to lands

children.text: देशजिनमें आसक्त मन जिनहीके ऐसे जे मनुष्यमति
children.translated_text: other than yours — such people are dull

children.text: मन्दहैं । तिनकी फूलनके समूह फूलिबेके मिस करिकै
children.translated_text: of intellect. The lofty trees on your banks, under the pretext of blooming with multitudes of flowers,

children.text: करतसदा हाँसीजे बलंदहैं ॥ औरै अपने जो मकरंदते
children.translated_text: always laugh at such people.

children.text: पबित्रकरैं आवै जो अलीनके महामलीन बृन्दहैं । तेई
children.translated_text: And with their own nectar they purify even the impure swarms of bees

children.text: वे हमारे नितसखा होउ मंदाकिनि तेरे तिरके जे तरु
children.translated_text: that come. Those very trees, may they always be our friends, O <s>Mandākinī</s> — the trees on your bank

children.text: आनँद के कन्दहैं ४३ एकजे पुरुषहैं ते जिनकी कठिन
children.translated_text: are bulbs of bliss. 43. Some persons there are who perform hard service of those gods,

children.text: सेव ऐसे देव तिन्हैं करैं यजन बिधान हैं । तिनते अपर
children.translated_text: worship them with ritual oblations.

children.text: यम नियम प्रमाण करैं कितनेहू बिधिवत करत वितान
children.translated_text: Others practice <s>yama</s> (restraint) and <s>niyama</s> (observance) with proper measures, performing elaborate ceremonies

children.text: हैं ॥ मैं तो गंगनाम नित सुमिरण तेरो करों जाते भये
children.translated_text: according to prescribed rites. But I simply remember your name, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, daily — by which

children.text: पूरेसब कामके निदान हैं । याते मैं जननी जो बिशाल
children.translated_text: all the foundations of desire have been fulfilled.

children.text: यह जक्त जालजानतहौं जाकोतृणजालके समानहैं ४४
children.translated_text: Therefore, O Mother, this vast net of the world — I regard it as no more than a net of grass. 44.

children.text: जन्महीते आदिलै निरंतर सकलविधि करत सुकृत ऐसे
children.translated_text: Those saints, who from birth onwards continuously perform all manner of meritorious acts, who are truly wise —

children.text: संतजे सुजानहैं । तिनके तोहित करिबेको मात मन्दा-
children.translated_text: to do them good, O Mother <s>Mandākinī</s>,

children.text: किनिकौनसे न जगमाहिं देवता प्रधानहैं ॥ अस्तभये
children.translated_text: what chief god in this world is there not? But those whose every support

children.text: सब अवलम्ब जिनहीके अरुकीने तिनकबहूंना सुकृत
children.translated_text: has perished and who have never performed any meritorious act —

children.text: बिधान हैं । ऐसे पुरुषनको या लोक परलोक माहिं तुम
children.translated_text: for such persons, in this world and the next, who other than you

children.text: बिना और कौनहितको निदानहैं ४५ शीघ्रही तुम्हारो
children.translated_text: is the cause of their welfare? 45. Having quickly drunk your milk, O Mother,

children.text: पय पानकरि एहोमातजात भयो क्रीड़ाको बिमूढ़सखा
children.translated_text: I went out, become a fool in the play

children.text: संगमैं । जाग्योदिनरैनि बहुख्यालनमें पाग्योरह्यो पायो
children.translated_text: of companions. Waking day and night, I wandered in many fancies and found

children.text: बिसराम कोनलेशकहूं गंगमैं ॥ दयायुत हृदय तुम्हारो
children.translated_text: not the least rest anywhere, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>.

children.text: जानिआयोअबनिद्राबश व्याकुलआलस भरयो अंग
children.translated_text: Knowing your heart to be full of compassion, I have now come — overpowered by drowsiness, restless, filled with laziness

children.text: मैं । पौनके प्रचारनसों शीतलजोताके मध्यस्वाऔचि-
children.translated_text: in every limb. With the blowing of the cool wind, for a long time

children.text: रकाल मोहिं निज उतसंग मैं ४६ कटिपै लपेटि खैंचि
children.translated_text: let me rest, O Mother, in your own lap. 46. Wrapping around the waist and pulling firmly,

children.text: एहोमात मंदाकिनि बाँधों दृढ़तासों परिकरहि सम्हारि
children.translated_text: O Mother <s>Mandākinī</s>, bind your girdle tightly, gathering yourself.

children.text: कै । बालक मयंक ताहि व्यालके समूहनसों निहचल
children.translated_text: The young moon — set it firmly amid the diadem

children.text: क्रीटबीच धरियेसुधारिकै ॥ साधारण और जेमनुष्य-
children.translated_text: of serpent multitudes, restoring it properly.

children.text: नके तारणकी बुद्धिते अवग्यामेरीकरो ना निहारिकै ।
children.translated_text: With the intent of delivering even ordinary humans,

children.text: होहु सावधान अंगसाहस बिधानकरि मेरे तारिबे को
children.translated_text: do not look upon me with contempt. Be alert, with bodily vigor and determination, for my deliverance —

children.text: यहसमयबिचारिकै ४७ शरदमयंकके समानश्वेत अंग
children.translated_text: consider this moment. 47. With a body radiant white like the autumn moon,

children.text: छबि शशिखण्डमंडित मुकुट द्युतिमानहैं । जाकी चारु
children.translated_text: resplendent with a crown adorned with a crescent moon — whose beautiful

children.text: चारिहू भुजान मैं बिराजमान कुम्भ औरपंकज अभय
children.translated_text: four arms bear a water-pot, a lotus, the gesture of fearlessness,

children.text: बरदान हैं ॥ अमृतकी धारासम धारैं बस्त्र आभूषण
children.translated_text: and the gesture of boon-granting.

children.text: बढ़ी श्वेत मकर पै शोभाको निधान हैं । ऐसो जो तु-
children.translated_text: Wearing garments and ornaments like streams of nectar, riding a great white <s>makara</s> (crocodile),

children.text: म्हारोबपु ध्यानकरैं एहो गंग तिनको जगतमैं न होत
children.translated_text: a treasure-house of beauty — those who meditate upon such a form of yours, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, never face

children.text: अपमानहैं ४८ रातिद्योस जिनके जगत ज्वालजालन
children.translated_text: dishonor in this world. 48. Day and night, those humans whose bodies are scorched

children.text: सों भूँजेअंग ऐसेनर तिनको दयासमेत । मंदमुसका-
children.translated_text: by the web of worldly flames — upon them, with compassion,

children.text: निते प्रकाशितबदनज्योतिजाकेजेतरंग सुधातिनतेजि-
children.translated_text: with a gentle smile illuminating the radiance of your face, your waves, like nectar,

children.text: वाइलेत ॥ औरैचैतन्यरूप स्वच्छचांदनी समूहजाको
children.translated_text: give them life. And the pure moonlight of consciousness

children.text: जो चमतकार ताकोबिसतारदेत । ऐसीतुमसंतनकीअं-
children.translated_text: that is your own — its wonder extends its expanse.

children.text: गनाजुएहोमात अबतौबिधानकरो मेरोकल्यानहेत ४९
children.translated_text: Such is your tenderness toward the saints, O Mother — now perform the rite for my welfare. 49.

children.text: यहसंसाररूप ब्यालबिकरालजानै डस्योअंगजाको सो
children.translated_text: This worldly existence is like a terrible serpent — know that I have been bitten, and

children.text: मैं पीड़ितहौं आठोयाम । मीलितसे मंत्रभये डरेदेव देखि
children.translated_text: I am in pain all eight watches of the day. The <s>mantras</s> (incantations) have been exhausted; the gods, seeing it, are afraid;

children.text: ताहि ओषधिप्रभावजापैनेकनकरतकाम ॥ गरुड़संबंधी
children.translated_text: the power of herbs and medicines does not work upon it at all.

children.text: जे पाहन फूटि छारभये खिसले हैं सघन सुधाके रसहू
children.translated_text: The stones connected with <s>Garuḍa</s> (the serpent-devourer) have cracked and turned to dust and slipped away; even the abundant essence

children.text: उदाम । कालीके दमन जाके चरणपखारे तुम हरौ सो
children.translated_text: of nectar is powerless. You whose feet have been washed by the subduer of <s>Kālī</s> — remove

children.text: हमारौताप एहोगंग सुखधाम ५० सर्पनकी श्रेणीगज
children.translated_text: our suffering, O <s>Gaṅgā</s>, abode of happiness. 50. The rows of serpents, the elephant-hide, the hosts of <s>pramathas</s> (Śiva's attendants), <s>Nandīśvara</s>, the moon — take all these and more, O generous

children.text: चर्म औ प्रमथ यूथ नंदीश्वर इंदु इन्हैं आदिलै उदार
children.translated_text: Lord (<s>Śiva</s>), who in the game of dice

children.text: भव । जूवामाहिं सरबस्वहारिकै बिचारि तुम्हैं दावँबिषे
children.translated_text: lost everything and, having considered it, placed you as a stake and formed the desire

children.text: धरिबेकी कीन्ही उरइच्छा जब ॥ जानिकै भवानी यह
children.translated_text: in his heart to wager you. Knowing this, <s>Bhavānī</s> (<s>Pārvatī</s>),

children.text: मंद मंद हांसीकरि एहोमात मंदाकिनि तुमको निहारैं
children.translated_text: with a slow, gentle laugh, O Mother <s>Mandākinī</s>, gazes upon you

children.text: तब । चंचल उतंग याते फैलीजे तरंगघटा तिनकोतां
children.translated_text: at that moment. Therefore your restless, surging waves have spread — with their tāṇḍava-like movement,

children.text: डवसो पवित्रकरौ हमैं अब ५१ ॥ छंदगीतिका ॥ की
children.translated_text: purify us now. 51. In the meter <s>gītikā</s>:

children.text: बिभूषित मदन रिपुको जिनहिं उत्तम अंग है । जै
children.translated_text: You have adorned the body of the enemy of <s>Madana</s> (<s>Kāma</s>, the love-god; i.e., <s>Śiva</s>) with the most excellent limbs.

children.text: अनेक न दीनजनकी करत आरत भंग है ॥ मनहर
children.translated_text: Victory to you who constantly break the suffering of the wretched.

children.text: उतंग तरंग जाकी चलत आनँदकी भरी । सोई हमा-
children.translated_text: Whose waves are enchanting, surging high, flowing full of joy —

children.text: रे अंग तिनको करौ पावन सुरसरी ५२ अभिराम
children.translated_text: purify our bodies, O river of the gods (<s>Surasarī</s>). 52. This beautiful work

children.text: नाम पियूष लहरी सकल मंगलकी भरी । यह जग-
children.translated_text: named <s>Pīyūṣalaharī</s> (Wave of Nectar), filled with all auspiciousness,

children.text: न्नाथ उदार पण्डितराज ने निर्मित करी ॥ इकद्योस
children.translated_text: was composed by the generous <s>Paṇḍitarāja Jagannātha</s>.

children.text: मिश्र उदाम सबगुण ग्रामरूप सुरामनै । इमि भांति उर
children.translated_text: <s>Ikadyosa Miśra</s>, of unbounded excellence, the embodiment of all virtues, with the heart's desire,

children.text: अभिलाष करि आयसु दई सुखधामनै ५३ यह देव
children.translated_text: gave the command at the abode of happiness. 53. This divine language, <s>Sanskrit</s>, is extremely difficult

children.text: बाणी संस्कृत अति कठिन समुझि न आवही । मति-
children.translated_text: and cannot be understood. People of dull intellect in the age of <s>Kali</s> —

children.text: मंदनर कलिकालके किहिभांति अर्थहि पावही ॥ यातें
children.translated_text: how will they grasp its meaning?

children.text: अरथ अनुकूलयाके जातमन हितलायकै । समझैं स-
children.translated_text: Therefore, having found its meaning congenial and beneficial to the mind,

children.text: कलनर भाषतामैं रचौं छंद बनाइकै ५४ यह धारिआ
children.translated_text: I compose it in the vernacular (<s>bhāṣā</s>) so that all people may understand, fashioning verses. 54. This order of the guru was borne upon the head,

children.text: यसु शीशगुरुकी बुद्धि निजअनुसारही । बलदेव वैश्य
children.translated_text: according to one's own intellect.

children.text: खँडेलवार बिचार जिन भाषा कही ॥ जे पढ़हिं याहि
children.translated_text: <s>Baladeva Vaiśya</s> of the <s>Khaṇḍelavāra</s> (Khandelwal) community considered and composed this vernacular rendering.

children.text: पढ़ावहीं अरु सुनहिं श्रवण करावहीं । तेईअनुग्रहगंग
children.translated_text: Those who read this, cause it to be read, hear it, or cause it to be heard,

children.text: की जयसंपदा नरपावहीं ५५ ॥ सोरठा ॥ शशि नभ
children.translated_text: they shall obtain the grace of <s>Gaṅgā</s> and attain victorious prosperity. 55. In the <s>soraṭhā</s> (couplet) meter:

children.text: नवभुवजानि हियअतिमोद बढाइकै । सकलसुमंगल
children.translated_text: Knowing the moon, sky, and nine earths, with great joy increasing in the heart,

children.text: खानि यह पियूष लहरी रची ५६ ॥
children.translated_text: this <s>Pīyūṣalaharī</s> (Wave of Nectar), a mine of all auspiciousness, was composed. 56.
Verse: This alone is the fortune that fills the entire earth — the <s>Vedas</s>

children.text: इतिश्रीपीयूषलहरीसम्पूर्णा ॥
children.translated_text: Thus ends the blessed <s>Pīyūṣalaharī</s> in its entirety.

children.text: मुन्शीनवलकिशोर (सी आई ई) के यंत्रालयमें छापीगई
नवम्बर सन् १८९० ई॰ ॥
children.translated_text: November 1890 CE.
